column1: # List prices in dollars per million tokens, read by tools/mk-cost.sh. One row per model, tab separated.
# A row "<model>><tokens>" is a second tier: its prices hold for every part of a request whose input,
# cache read and cache write together are MORE than <tokens>. as_of is the day the source was read.
# A model that is not here is an unknown model to the meter: above 1 percent of the rounds it prints no number.
